about: Zeist Chess's Game Center achievements: ids, words, points and what each image shows. They mark feats against the engines and in puzzles; none rewards a streak, a daily visit or speed, and none names a level number. The app reports them (ios/ZeistChess/Account/GameCenter.swift); ios/scripts/achievements.mjs draws the images. The Zeist engine has no achievements of its own here: beating it is rewarded in Zeist's Game Center, where those games are rated. It still counts toward the two that cover every engine.
